before.name: Cyberpunk 2077 (Night City)
before.description:
Night City has advanced machine intelligence and a sharp separation between protected wealth and exposed poverty. The game's North Oak entry describes an elite district created after a corporate-backed eviction, which makes an assumption of reliable universal material access untenable. Production and urban power sit close to the concentrated corporate band rather than broad control by ordinary residents.

Corporations and powerful human institutions direct most productive resources. Independent AIs exist, but their presence does not establish a citywide machine government. This remains a zero-variant comparison of persistent labor and insecurity alongside demonstrated technological capacity, without inventing a benevolent job-protection policy. The best-guess nonworking fraction is modest because paid service, maintenance, care and informal survival activity remain useful work. It includes dependents and displaced people, with a wide uncertainty interval. The point is an editorial reading of participation, not a census and not the proportion of time a character spends on a job.

before.description:
On twenty-fourth-century Earth, the familiar link between earning money and meeting material needs has largely disappeared. Replicators and supporting infrastructure make everyday goods readily available, and choosing a vocation is presented as a matter of interest and contribution. The strong guarantee score describes this ordinary civilian baseline. It is not a claim that every frontier settlement or wartime starship enjoys the same conditions.

Shared civilian institutions keep productive control toward the distributed human end, while Starfleet’s chain of command does not describe all of Earth. For participation, the best guess is that about half the scoped population does no ongoing useful work. The interval is deliberately wide because many residents may choose demanding vocations, research, care or creative contribution even when necessities are free. Those activities still count as work. This is an editorial population scenario, not a quoted Federation unemployment rate, and frontier shortages do not erase the ordinary Earth baseline.

before.name: Mass Effect 3 — Paragon Control reconstruction

scope.period: Successful Paragon-leaning Control epilogue and projected early reconstruction
scope.population: Living human survivors aided by Shepard-directed Reapers

before.description:
Control gives the transformed Shepard command of the Reapers, which then help rebuild the galaxy and repair its transport network. That is real large-scale productive assistance, so the record no longer waits for a complete postwar constitution before including the case. The moderately favorable guarantee estimate projects protection and access under the Paragon guardian reading. It does not claim that the ending explicitly abolishes wages, grants universal housing or eliminates shortages on every damaged world.

Control lies strongly toward autonomous machine authority because the original embodied human is replaced by a powerful coordinating intelligence directing the Reaper fleet. Its human origin remains visible, but ordinary citizens have no demonstrated means of overriding it. A moderate nonworking estimate retains useful reconstruction, care and scientific work despite extraordinary machine support. The record excludes the more coercive Renegade narrative and other endings. Its human-only participation percentage and postwar material floor are low-confidence best guesses, not narration supplied by the game.

scope.branch: Temperance-compatible transfer to Alt, conditional on continued active personhood

before.description:
Joining Alt beyond the Blackwall offers a possible human-derived digital existence outside ordinary bodily work and ownership. The selected ending establishes the transfer, while its continuing economy remains an openly projected best guess. Computing support replaces food and shelter as the material requirement, and access is precarious rather than a universal right. The unfavorable guarantee point reflects dependence on an autonomous environment, not proof that every archived engram remains an independent person.

Control lies strongly toward autonomous AI because human-derived entrants cannot simply command the surrounding systems. A moderate nonworking estimate allows freedom from bodily employment while retaining useful computation, care-like assistance, exploration and technical activity. Its denominator is active experiencing constructs only: stored data, absorbed identities without continued agency and dead biological originals are excluded. The broad interval and conditional personhood assumption are essential. The record does not turn an ending into a guaranteed digital paradise or claim that every rogue AI territory has the same rules.
